name: Tenacious Defender makes Libram of Tenacity heal (#3126)
contract: Libram of Tenacity 801461 effect 1 is a percent-of-maximum-health heal whose base value is zero; its description only promises the heal while Tenacious Defender 707385 is known. That talent is a +20 flat SPELLMOD_EFFECT1 passive on the Libram's family mask, so the talented Templar's effect value is 20.
